ios.desc:
Discover the perfect places to dine with Yumbox, your go-to app for finding and tracking favorite eateries. Whether plotting your next culinary adventure or satisfying an immediate craving, Yumbox offers a seamless way to explore and decide.

Effortlessly navigate through restaurants with our intuitive map and list view. Looking for a cozy Italian bistro nearby or an affordable sushi spot? Use our powerful filter options to narrow down choices by cuisine type, price range, customer rating, or proximity. Every meal becomes an experience as you craft the perfect outing tailored to your tastes and budget.

With Yumbox, uncover hidden gems around the corner or must-visit spots in new cities. Your decision-making is streamlined, enabling you to spend less time searching and more time savoring. Start making dining out as enjoyable as the meal itself with organized lists and easy-to-use features designed just for you. Explore with confidence and satisfy every culinary urge with Yumbox.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Yumbox, iOS app to track and filter your fav restaurants (No signup)

quotes.text: After 8 months I have launched my first app Yumbox. It helps you track your favorite restaurants with many visualization modes and filtering options. You can explore your saved restaurants through a map or a list. You can filter, visualize (in the map) and sort by food type, price, rating, or distance. Whether you’re planning a trip or craving something at the moment, Yumbox will help you choose the best option
